title: Pueblos y fronteras
goal: Read how new national borders cut straight through communities that had never organized themselves that way — the Aymara people, split across three countries, being the clearest case.

items: Explain whether official borders matched communities' actual lived reality.
Describe what happened to Aymara territories after the War of the Pacific.
Explain whether Aymara cross-border ties continued despite the new division.
Explain whether this pattern was unique to the Aymara.
